definitions.explanation: The Japanese language and literature from the Heian period through the early modern period. A required subject in Japanese high schools.
Any text written in an older form of a language.

⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{古文|こぶん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese education, {古文|こぶん} specifically refers to classical Japanese texts (as opposed to ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧, classical Chinese texts read in Japanese). Both are required subjects in high school. Students learn to read works like {源氏物語|げんじものがたり} (The Tale of Genji) and {枕草子|まくらのそうし} (The Pillow Book).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古文|こぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ (classical Japanese class)
- {古文|こぶん}⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ (classical Japanese vocabulary)
- {古文|こぶん}⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧ (classical Japanese grammar)
- {古文|こぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read classical texts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧: classical Chinese (read in Japanese) — paired subject in schools
- ⟦{古語|こご}→古語：12065_kogo⟧: archaic word — refers to individual old words, not texts
